entities.name: Mephidross
entities.description: A toxic swamp of sludge, waste and corroding machines on Mirrodin, center of Moriok culture.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The artificial world where the Mephidross lay.

entities.name: Ish Sah
entities.description: A fortress at the center of the swamp.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: Ruler of the Moriok who dwelt in Ish Sah.

entities.name: Moriok
entities.description: Human occupants of the Dross affected by the Necrogen Mists.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Mad guardian whose machines fought in the Leveler War.

entities.name: Leveler War
entities.description: War against Memnarch's machines and the Nim.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Advanced on Mirrodin, causing the Dross to expand.

entities.name: Seven Steel Thanes
entities.description: Rulers of fiefdoms within the Dross.

entities.name: Dross Pits
entities.description: A new layer in Phyrexia where the Mephidross was siphoned and the Thanes dwell.

entities.name: Vraan
entities.description: Leader of the Bleak Coven of vampire assassins.

entities.name: Bleak Coven
entities.description: Order of the most skilled vampire assassins.

events.summary: During the Leveler War the Mephidross advances into other territories until Memnarch is put down.
events.quote: until the mad guardian was put down

events.summary: As Phyrexia advances the Dross swallows parts of the Tangle and Razorgrass Fields while the Seven Steel Thanes vie for control.
events.quote: jockeying for control over the swamplands

events.summary: Mirrodin is compleated into New Phyrexia and the Mephidross is siphoned into the Dross Pits.
events.quote: siphoned out entirely into a new layer within Phyrexia, the Dross Pits
